items.title: A general technique for explicit quantile representations
items.summary: arXiv:2611.06459v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This work proves existence of contours independent of probability level for exact quantile integrals of strictly positive real-analytic densities. Explicit constructions cover five broad distribution families and yield a finite-interval representation of Black-Scholes implied volatility using forward functions.
